metadata.title: Freelancer Bookkeeping Service Platform Deployment Channels
metadata.description: Product bricks are deployed to the web applications (the client web app at mijn.keesdeboekhouder.nl, the bookkeeper workspace back office and the public website with appointment booking and partner pages), to the iOS and Android client app (photo capture, dashboard, invoices, notifications), to integrations (Ponto/Isabel PSD2 bank connection to Knab, Rabobank, ABN AMRO, bunq and other banks, the Belastingdienst filing channel, KVK, e-mail-in receipts and outbound e-mail, payment providers, Google Meet scheduling), to document outputs (PDF quotes and invoices, annual accounts, filed return copies, payslips) and to internal operations (QA and allocation tooling, subscription billing, partner programme administration, security and AVG). Proprietary software with a personal bookkeeper on top; each deployed brick records the products that use it.

channels.description: The browser surfaces of the platform: the client web app at mijn.keesdeboekhouder.nl, the bookkeeper workspace back office used by the Amsterdam, Rotterdam and Utrecht offices, and the public websites keesdeboekhouder.nl and founders.nl with appointment booking, pricing and partner pages. Proprietary software, no installation, AVG-compliant access limited to the client and authorised staff.

Where every client logs in: the financial dashboard and VAT position, to-dos and notifications, Scan & Herken uploads, expense bookings, the document archive, quotes and invoices, bank transactions and matching, messaging with the personal bookkeeper, and the subscription overview.
